evidence: PROCEDURE DIVISION USING with multiple areas

purpose.summary: This is a screen navigation/confirmation subprogram (screen 2, KID2) within the ORCA JMA standard medical receipt software system. It handles button-click events on a confirmation screen, setting flags (SPA-KID2-FLG) to indicate which print/action option was selected (e.g., prescription info, medicine info, all, register), then navigates back to the originating screen via a PUT-WINDOW call.
purpose.domain: healthcare/medical (Japanese medical association receipt processing system)

notable_features: Japanese-language comments (Shift-JIS/EUC-JP encoded, rendered as latin-1 mojibake)
ORCA JMA open-source medical receipt software project
Heavy use of COPY statements for screen layout includes (K01.INC through KERR2.INC, KID1.INC, KID2.INC, etc.)
EVALUATE ALSO construct for multi-condition branching on MCP-STATUS/MCP-EVENT/MCP-WIDGET
CALL 'ORCDBMAIN' for MCP (Message Control Program) window management
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Only 1 PIC clause in working storage (rest via COPY)
verdict.notes: The file is encoded in a Japanese encoding (likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS) but decoded as latin-1, causing the Japanese comments to appear as mojibake. The label 'grpsys' appearing inline before the CALL statement at column 1 is unusual and may be a label or artifact. The program is clearly part of the well-known ORCA (JMA standard receipt software) open-source medical system used in Japan.
